_seo: seoTitle and seoDescription (at most 160 characters) replace the game page's <title> and meta description at build time, so search results say what each game is. The game repo's own text stays as the fallback.

games.seoTitle: Overprint – Free Daily Word Puzzle | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Turn and restack punched cards until every row spells a word. Two new solver-checked puzzles a day, a 60-sheet journey and free play. Free, no ads.

games.seoTitle: Lookout – Free Daily Logic Puzzle | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Plant hedges so every robot lookout sees exactly its number. Three new logic grids a day, a 40-level journey and hints that explain why. Free, no ads.

games.seoTitle: Rungs – Free Daily Word Ladder Puzzle | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Change one letter at a time to climb from one word to another. Three new word ladders every day, a 60-ladder journey and endless practice. Free, no ads.

games.seoTitle: Soupspell – Daily Alphabet Soup Word Game | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Stir floating letters together and trace touching ones to spell words. A new Daily Bowl for everyone, a 90-second Rush and endless Zen. Free, no ads.

games.seoTitle: Rickety – Bridge Building Physics Puzzle | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Build a bridge on a budget, then watch a robot cart cross it, or not. 24 levels, a new canyon every day where the cheapest bridge wins, and a sandbox.

games.seoTitle: Star Post – Gravity Slingshot Puzzle | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: One launch, then gravity curves your robot courier through every mailbox to the dock. 30 hand-built star systems and a new daily delivery. Free, no ads.

games.seoTitle: Odd One Out – Robot Survival Arcade Game | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Steer the one mismatched robot through endless crowds while your gadgets fire on their own. Survive 10 minutes, beat the bosses, upgrade between runs.

games.seoTitle: Wonky Putt – Mini Golf with a Daily Hole | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Mini golf on 18 wonky holes of windmills, portals, bumpers and thin ice. Beat par for stars and take one shot at a new daily hole every day. Free, no ads.

games.seoTitle: Blinkwire – Daily Wire Rotation Puzzle | Oddvale Games
games.seoDescription: Rotate wire tiles until every sleepy eye joins the Big Eye. A new daily board with streaks, a 60-level journey and free play up to 12x12. Free, no ads.
